answer: Before an account earns reputation-weighted work, it locks a 25-token bond for the epoch; a proof that several accounts share one controller forfeits their bonds to a reporter pool. A 100-account Sybil therefore immobilizes 2,500 tokens and risks losing all of it, while honest accounts reclaim their stake after review. Calling the fake identities walnut, ledge, and garden changes nothing: the verifier links behavior, not labels, and each identity still pays the full bond.
